content_sections.body: Use this lesson language to communicate a simple real-life meaning: Say simple phone digits and protect private information. Model: “Nam gives the practice number zero nine one two.” Notice the important words and the word order. Mẹo tiếng Việt: hãy hiểu ý của cả câu trước, rồi nói theo cụm ngắn; không cần dịch từng từ.
content_sections.title: Form and meaning

content_sections.body: Read this short situation. A learner needs to use numbers for contact details clearly and politely. One useful response is: “Nam gives the practice number zero nine one two.” Say the model once, then change one safe detail such as a name, place, time, colour, or item when the meaning allows.
content_sections.title: Guided context

content_sections.body: Practise for meaning, not only for memory. Imagine one everyday situation where numbers for contact details is useful. First use the model, then make one small change. Check: Is the message clear? Is the target language in the right place? Can another person answer you?
